title: U.S. crude near $90 as Iran retaliates with strikes on Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain
summary_full: Oil prices were volatile Wednesday, as Mideast tensions continue to escalate after the U.S. attacked Iran, while Tehran reportedly struck back at U.S. allies.
